observe-run.description: Observe the change a CI job built, in a repository that keeps its own CI and needs no Putnami workspace. It detects GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or another CI by the variable it sets in every job, names the repository by its code host and numeric project id, resolves the commit the change is measured against, deepening a shallow clone up to the merge base, lists the changed files, and finds the test and coverage reports, the software bills of materials (SBOM) and the ArchUnit, deptrac and import-linter results the job produced; an SBOM gives each changed dependency its licenses and known vulnerabilities, and each architecture violation goes to the component that holds its file. It lists the MADR decision records whose scope covers a changed file, and those the change adds, edits or deletes. A missing or malformed report, or a base it cannot reach, is a diagnostic: it exits 0 whatever it observes, 2 on a usage error and 1 when it cannot read its job context or write its output. It prints a text summary, or one JSON document with --output=json. In the caller's directory it writes only the Git history it fetches, which --no-fetch turns off, and the change evidence document --evidence names. --upload hands that document to the evidence reporter extension, and --publish posts a commit status and one summary note on the pull or merge request; neither fails the job.

base.description: Commit or branch the change is measured against; overrides what the CI says. Required for a CI other than GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.

head.description: Commit that was built; default HEAD.

junit.description: Comma-separated JUnit XML or TRX report paths or glob patterns; replaces test report discovery.

coverage.description: Comma-separated coverage report paths or glob patterns (LCOV, Cobertura, Clover, JaCoCo or Kover, Go cover profile); replaces coverage discovery.

sbom.description: Path or glob pattern of the software bill of materials of the commit (CycloneDX 1.4 to 1.6 or SPDX 2.3, JSON); replaces SBOM discovery. Gives each changed dependency its licences and known vulnerabilities.

base-sbom.description: Path or glob pattern of the software bill of materials of the base; without it the base state of each dependency is unknown.

architecture.description: Comma-separated paths or glob patterns of the architecture reports: the deptrac --formatter=junit report and the lint-imports output saved as text; replaces their discovery. ArchUnit results come from the JUnit reports.

archunit-classes.description: Comma-separated class name patterns, such as *ArchitectureTest, whose JUnit cases are ArchUnit rules rather than tests, besides the test classes that import com.tngtech.archunit.

moon-graph.description: Path of the moon project graph export (moon project-graph --json); default moon-graph.json at the repository root when it exists. Without one, the moon projects come from .moon/workspace.yml and each moon.yml.

pants-graph.description: Path of the Pants export the CI wrote with `pants peek :: > pants-graph.json`; default pants-graph.json at the repository root. Gives a Pants repository the dependencies Pants infers from imports.

bazel-graph.description: Path of the Bazel query export, from bazel query 'deps(//...)' --output=streamed_jsonproto; default bazel-graph.json at the repository root. Gives the edges between the Bazel packages.

fetch.description: Fetch the base and deepen a shallow clone up to the merge base; --no-fetch reads only the local history.

evidence.description: Write the change evidence document (protocol/evidence v1) to this path, resolved against the invocation directory.

upload.description: Hand the change evidence document to the evidence reporter: the extension PUTNAMI_EVIDENCE_REPORTER names, @putnami/cloud when unset. A failed upload is a diagnostic; the exit code does not change.

open.description: Upload as --upload does; outside a CI, let the reporter sign the person in when no credential is present and open the report URL in the browser. A failed upload is a diagnostic; the exit code does not change.

details.description: Print the detailed summary: the changed files, the reports, each component's tests and coverage, each dependency change, the decisions and the specs, instead of the short summary.

publish.description: Post a commit status and one summary note, updated in place on the next run, on the pull request (GITHUB_TOKEN) or merge request (PUTNAMI_GITLAB_TOKEN). A missing token, a job outside a pull or merge request and a refused call are diagnostics; the exit code does not change.

decisions.description: Repository directories that hold MADR decision records, comma-separated; default docs/decisions and docs/adr. The summary and the evidence document list the decisions whose scope covers a changed file and the records the change adds, edits or deletes.

observe.description: Observe a change in a repository that keeps its own CI.

run.description: Detect the CI, the diff base, the changed files and the reports of this job.

examples.description: In a GitHub Actions or GitLab CI job, after the tests.
In another CI, measured against main.
Name the reports and print one JSON document.
Give each changed dependency the licences and known vulnerabilities two SBOMs the job wrote list.
Show the architecture rules deptrac and import-linter checked, and place each violation on its component.
In a Pants repository, read the dependencies Pants infers from the export `pants peek :: > dist/pants-graph.json` wrote.
Keep the change evidence document as a CI artifact.
Upload the change evidence to Putnami Cloud; the job sets PUTNAMI_CLOUD_TOKEN.
Post the summary on the pull or merge request; the job sets GITHUB_TOKEN or PUTNAMI_GITLAB_TOKEN.
